# openprovider_domain_transfer_restart (Resource)

Sends a transfer that failed to the registry again, without a new order. The restart occurs when Terraform creates or replaces the resource. A change of an attribute that the configuration sets replaces the resource. The domain must have the status `FAI`. With a different status, or when the account has no such domain, the apply fails and the provider sends no restart. The deletion of the resource does not change the domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send a transfer that failed to the registry again, for example after the
# holder gives a corrected auth code. A change of `triggers` restarts it again.
resource "openprovider_domain_transfer_restart" "example" {
  domain    = "example.com"
  auth_code = var.auth_code

  triggers = {
    attempt = "2"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name (e.g., example.com).

### Optional

- `auth_code` (String, Sensitive) The auth code to send with the restart. Terraform keeps this value in the state.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values. A change of a value restarts the transfer again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain name.
